27.cause: Annotator dropped the additive adverb 'also' as having no semantic content.
27.convention: Additive/focus adverbs such as 亦/也 are kept as a :mod of the event.

27.kind: Wrong aspect on 满足-01 (process instead of performance) and missing :ARG0 sharing on 购入-01 wrongly placed
27.cause: Annotator chose process for the purpose clause, whereas gold treats it as performance. Annotator also placed the ARG0 of 购入 in a different arrangement than gold, creating an arg-structure mismatch (ARG0 on 购入 is present in annotator, reported partial because the referent concept differs).
27.convention: Purpose clauses with a bounded, completed-type event take aspect performance.

27.kind: Wrong temporal structure: 自制 overlap 购入 expected, annotator put both as DCT overlaps; extra DCT overlap for 定下; wrong DCT anchor for 购入
27.cause: Annotator attached every event to the document creation time separately instead of anchoring the main 自制 event to the DCT and relating the others (购入, 满足, 制作) to it. It also added a DCT relation for the relative clause event 定下.
27.convention: In a coordinated/purpose structure, only the main event is anchored to DCT; the other events are linked by :overlap to it, and embedded relative-clause events are not anchored to DCT.

27.kind: Wrong coreference: 自制 节目 linked as superset of earlier 制作 in s13; company chain linked incorrectly
27.cause: Annotator inferred a subset-of relation between the generic 电视节目 here and a previous event in s13, which the gold does not make. The company chain also differs, linking different mentions (e.g. 'show' in s28) than gold.
27.convention: Only annotate subset-of coreference when the sentence clearly indicates a part-whole relation among the same type of entities; do not link generic mentions loosely.

28.kind: Named show entity typed as a generic 新闻节目 with the name attached to it, instead of a 'show' named entity identified (identity-91) with a 节目 concept
28.cause: Annotator collapsed the title and the descriptive noun phrase into one node (新闻节目 with name) instead of splitting into a named 'show' and an identity-91 to a 节目 with a 新闻 modifier. Dropped the 新闻 and 节目 concepts and put the 自制 as a plain mod.
28.convention: A named work/title is a named entity of a general type (e.g. show) and its appositive or descriptive noun phrase is linked by identity-91 (ARG1 the named entity, ARG2 the description). Modifier nouns such as 新闻 are separate concept nodes with :mod.

28.kind: 自制 treated as a plain modifier state instead of an event 自制-01 with ARG0 the company and aspect performance
28.check: b_event_sense, a_entity_found, c_aspect, d_core_args_event, d_peripheral_entity, i_modal, h_temporal
28.cause: Annotator treated 自制 as an adjective-like concept and did not use the verbal predicate with the producer as ARG0 in a relative-clause reading. This lost the company entity, the aspect, and the related temporal and modal relations.
28.convention: Modifying participial or verbal words (e.g. 自制) are annotated as predicates with a sense (-01), with the agent as ARG0 via ARG1-of, and receive aspect and modal/temporal relations.

28.kind: Station name annotated as ARG0 of 播放 with type 电视台, instead of a company (producer of 自制) modifying the show
28.check: a_entity_concept, a_entity_found, d_core_args_event, e_core_labels, f_name_tokens, j_coref_chain
28.cause: Annotator interpreted 城市电视 as the broadcaster-agent of 播放 and gave it the 电视台 concept. The gold treats it as the company that produced the show (ARG0 of 自制), typed as company, and links coreference to the company in the previous sentences. The annotator then linked the wrong antecedent (s27t) and a wrong chain for 节目.
28.convention: Organization names are typed 'company' (or the relevant named-entity type) and attach to the predicate they syntactically modify; 播放 here has no explicit ARG0. Coreference chains link all mentions of the same organization.

28.kind: Time of day annotated as strings in date-entity (and a frequency of temporal-quantity 晚) instead of hXXmYY time values
28.cause: Annotator wrote times as quoted strings like "19:30" and added a rate-entity ARG3 for 每晚, while the gold encodes the time as an entity such as h19m30 under date-entity and has only ARG4. For 23:40 it also used temporal-quantity wrongly for a time.
28.convention: Clock times are annotated as time-entity concepts like h19m30 (hour/minute) under :time of date-entity, not as strings. Rate-entity-91 for 每晚 uses only the ARG4 time without an extra ARG3 quantity.

28.kind: 当晚 treated as a date-entity mod and the 23:30 time written as a string; 回放 given -01 sense and ARG0/ARG1 where gold uses -00
28.cause: Annotator added 当晚 as a modifier concept and used a PropBank-style -01 for 回放, which has no frame. Gold drops 当晚 and uses -00 for an unframed predicate, with ARG1 only.
28.convention: Predicates without a PropBank frame use -00. Deictic phrases already expressed by the time value are not separate concepts.

28.kind: Program length sentence structured with 是-01 and a nested and over durations, instead of two identity-91 clauses sharing 长度 with 节目 as mod
28.check: a_event_concept, d_core_args_abstract, d_peripheral_entity, e_core_labels, c_aspect, h_temporal, i_modal
28.cause: Annotator used a copular verb 是 with ARG0/ARG1 and put the weekday/weekend temporal inside the quantities, and used poss for the program. Gold splits into two identity-91 predications (ARG1 长度, ARG2 quantity) with :temporal on the predicate, 节目 as :mod of 长度, and aspect state on each. As a result the second clause lacked its own modal and temporal relations.
28.convention: Copular 是/为 equating a thing with a value is identity-91 with ARG1 and ARG2; contrastive clauses are split into separate coordinated predications, each with aspect state; temporal modifiers attach to the predicate. Noun modifiers use :mod.

28.kind: Document-level temporal relations differ: annotator used DCT overlap for each event and 播放 before 回放, while gold has 播放 overlapping the other events and before 自制
28.cause: Annotator anchored every clause to document-creation-time and invented an ordering between 播放 and 回放 from the later broadcast time. Gold treats habitual events as overlapping the main event 播放.
28.convention: Habitual/state clauses in the same sentence are related as overlap with the main event; only the main event is anchored to the document-creation-time.

29.kind: Location name structure wrong: one entity with merged two-token name and wrong type, instead of separate building and city entities with nested :place
29.cause: The annotator treated 列治文 时代坊 as a single named place and typed it as 商场 (mall), instead of splitting it into the city 列治文 and the building 时代坊, which is nested inside the city.
29.convention: Compound place names that contain a larger place and a smaller one are split into separate named entities, each with its own type (city, building), linked by :place from the smaller to the larger. Use the standard UMR named-entity types (city, building), not language-specific common nouns.

29.kind: Person entity type wrong: 'person' used instead of 'individual-person'
29.cause: The annotator used the generic concept person for named individuals, whereas the gold uses the UMR named-entity type individual-person.
29.convention: Named human individuals are typed as individual-person, not person.

29.kind: Temporal relation between the two coordinated events wrong: both events were attached only to the document-creation-time instead of the second one being linked to the first
29.cause: The annotator gave each clause its own :overlap with document-creation-time, rather than anchoring the first to DCT and chaining the second to the first.
29.convention: In coordinated or sequential clauses describing co-occurring habitual events, the later event is linked to the preceding event (:overlap) rather than independently to the document-creation-time.

29.kind: Spurious :poss added on 主播 and coreference wrongly attached to 节目 in sentence 28; the wrong antecedent was chosen
29.cause: The annotator added an inferred possessor (:poss 节目) not present in the text, and linked 节目 to a different earlier mention (s28j) than the gold chain (s28s, 'show'). The antecedent choice differs from the gold.
29.convention: Do not add implicit relations that are not expressed in the sentence. Coreference links the mention to the same entity node that the gold chain uses (the head mention of the earlier show).

30.kind: Named organizations given as generic concept 电视台 instead of 'company' (and 'country'/'country-region' for place names)
30.cause: Annotator used the surface noun 电视台 as the concept for named TV stations instead of the UMR named-entity type 'company'. The gold uses English named-entity types for names.
30.convention: Named entities take a standard English NE-type concept (company, country, country-region, broadcast-program) rather than the surface common noun.

30.kind: Station names split wrongly: 电视台 kept inside the name, 中国 and 台湾 folded into the name instead of being place entities
30.cause: Annotator put '中国 中央 电视台' and '台湾 TVBS' as flat names. The gold separates the country/region as a :place entity (country, country-region) and keeps only '中央 电视台' / 'TVBS' as the company name.
30.convention: A geographic modifier inside an organization name is annotated as a separate :place entity (country / country-region) with its own name; it is not part of the organization's name.

30.kind: Coordinated possessors not distributed: single 新闻节目 with :poss and over the two stations, instead of an and of two 节目 each with 新闻 mod and :possessor
30.cause: Annotator kept 新闻节目 as a single compound concept with a coordinated possessor. The gold splits 新闻 off as :mod and creates one 节目 per possessor under an and. The relation label is :possessor, not :poss.
30.convention: Compound nouns are split into head plus :mod (新闻 + 节目). Coordinated possessors are distributed over separate head instances. Possession uses :possessor.

30.cause: Annotator dropped the adverb 亦 in both clauses. The gold keeps it as a :mod 亦 on each event.
30.convention: Focus/additive adverbs such as 亦 are kept as :mod concepts on the event.

30.kind: Instrument 以卫星技术 labelled :manner instead of :instrument
30.cause: Annotator treated 以 + technology as manner. The gold treats it as the means used, :instrument.

30.kind: 播出 attached as a relative clause on the news programs (ARG1-of) instead of a separate third conjunct event
30.cause: Annotator embedded 于下列时间播出 inside the 新闻节目 as ARG1-of. The gold makes it a separate conjunct 播出-01 (op3 of the top-level and) with ARG1 pointing to the programs. This also changes the temporal relations (the annotator has 引入 :before 播出; gold has DCT :overlap 播出).
30.convention: A trailing clause predicating a further event on an already-mentioned entity is a separate coordinated event that re-uses the entity as ARG1 (reentrancy), not a nested modifier.

30.kind: Wrong concept and role for 包括: include-91 with :ARG2-of instead of 包括-01 with :ARG0-of; missing state aspect
30.check: a_event_concept, e_core_labels, d_core_args_event, c_aspect, h_temporal, i_modal
30.cause: Annotator used the English UMR abstract concept include-91 for 包括. The gold keeps the Chinese lemma 包括-01 as an event, with the 节目 as ARG0 and :aspect state. Because it is an event, it gets temporal (自制 :overlap 包括) and modal (author :full-affirmative) relations that the annotator lacks.
30.convention: For Chinese, 包括 'include' is annotated as the verb 包括-01 (ARG0 = whole, ARG1 = parts) with :aspect state, and takes its own temporal and modal annotations; it is not mapped to include-91.

30.kind: Program titles: concept 节目 with name instead of broadcast-program; book-title brackets 《 》 left out of name tokens; wrong token set
30.cause: Annotator typed titles as 节目 and dropped the 《 》 punctuation from the names. The gold types them broadcast-program and includes 《 and 》 as name tokens. The annotator's name tokens also did not match the gold's, e.g. the missing 《 城市 大 视界 》 token set.
30.convention: Titles are typed with an English NE class (broadcast-program), and quotation/title brackets are included as name tokens.

30.kind: Station 城市电视 typed as 电视台 instead of company
30.cause: Same as the other named-organization concept errors: the surface noun was used for the ARG0 entity.

30.kind: Temporal relations between 引入 and 自制 wrong
30.cause: Annotator tied each event to the document-creation-time separately. The gold chains the coordinated habitual events with :overlap (引入 :overlap 自制 :overlap 包括).
30.convention: Coordinated habitual events in the same sentence are linked with :overlap in a chain.

30.kind: Coreference antecedent wrong sentence and chain incomplete
30.cause: Annotator linked s30t to s28t (a 'show' entity) rather than to the company entity of s27. The chain therefore diverges from the gold station chain.
30.convention: The station's mentions are chained across sentences to the same company entity.

31.kind: Time values written as strings instead of UMR time-of-day concepts (h10m00 etc.)
31.cause: Annotator put clock times as quoted strings in :time ("10:00") rather than as hXXmYY entity nodes under :time
31.convention: Clock times are annotated as :time of a date-entity with a time-of-day value node in hHHmMM format (e.g. h10m00), not as quoted strings

31.kind: Range of times annotated as 'and' instead of 'range'
31.cause: Annotator treated 'between X and Y' as coordination of two time points, not a range
31.convention: A span 'between A and B' (介乎 A 和 B) is a range with :op1/:op2 date-entities as ARG1 of the predicate

31.kind: Company name annotated as 电视台 instead of company
31.cause: Annotator used the surface word as concept for a named organization instead of the standard 'company' concept
31.convention: Named organizations/companies get the general concept (company) with a :name, not the surface word as concept

31.kind: Wrong relation labels for program/time-slot structure (:mod/:poss instead of :medium/:possessor/:temporal-of)
31.cause: Annotator made 节目 a modifier of 时段 and used generic :mod for language and :poss for the owner, instead of the gold structure with 时段 :temporal-of 节目, language as :medium, owner as :possessor
31.convention: Language of a program is :medium; possessor is :possessor; a time slot of a program is expressed as 时段 :temporal-of 节目

31.kind: Second clause: 播放 made the main event with 介乎 as :temporal, instead of a parallel 介乎-01 with the program as ARG0 and 播放 as relative clause
31.cause: Annotator did not recognize the elided/parallel 介乎 structure and took 播放 as the clause head, nesting the second 介乎 under it with a self-referential ARG0 (s31p)
31.convention: In parallel clauses with ellipsis (则 介乎...), the repeated predicate heads the second conjunct with the thing it describes as ARG0; a modifying verb like 播放 is expressed as ARG1-of on the noun

31.kind: Temporal relations wrong: DCT overlap on 播放 and 播放 overlap 介乎, instead of first 介乎 overlap second 介乎
31.cause: Consequence of the wrong structure of the second conjunct; annotator linked the event nodes it created
31.convention: Coordinated state events get temporal relation between the two conjunct heads; the modifying 播放 gets no separate DCT relation

31.kind: Coreference chain mislinked: antecedent entity from previous sentence and chain differ (company vs show / 该台 chain)
31.cause: Annotator's coref points to the 电视台 node (s31t) rather than the company node, and the chain from earlier sentences differs in membership (included a show node in gold, i.e. 28 mention)
31.convention: Mentions of the same company are chained via :same-entity to the company node; the chain follows the company concept

31.kind: Missing modal for 播放 event as modeled in gold (annotator's modal on its own nodes)
31.cause: Follows from the structural difference; modal annotation placed on s31p/s31b rather than on the ARG1-of 播放 and second 介乎
